APPLIED AI ENGINEERING

Engineering The Future With AI, Tailored To Your Needs

We combine multidisciplinary engineering with AI expertise to build production-ready solutions shaped around your workflows, infrastructure, and needs.

Our Services Our Work

Welcome to the Future, Welcome to Mirai

Mirai, the Japanese word for future, is more than just our name: it's our mission. We deliver real-world AI models applied to your industry, using the future's technology, today. As engineers, we are problem solvers. We help you cut through the complexity and noise surrounding AI solutions so you can gain a clear understanding of how they work. From there, we guide you through a seamless implementation designed to meet your unique needs.

What We Offer

We provide comprehensive AI services tailored to your business journey. Our consultancy helps you understand how AI can transform your operations, while our implementation services deliver strategic roadmaps and custom AI solutions. We also offer hands-on workshops that provide practical training with measurable results, ensuring your team is equipped to leverage AI effectively.

Learn more

Industries We Serve

We deliver proven AI solutions across diverse industries, from technical analysis in fintech, research & development in engineering, or imaging analysis for object detection & segmentation in healthcare & automotive, to advanced data processing. Your field of expertise together with our human-to-AI translation capabilities deliver measurable results tailored to each sector's unique challenges and objectives.

Success Stories & Case Studies

Real-world implementations delivering measurable results

📱

Intelligent Calorie Tracking with On-Device AI

Consumer Health

Nutrition Mate demonstrates how small, specialized AI can live directly inside a mobile product. Users log meals in one natural sentence, while an on-device model parses foods and quantities in seconds with no cloud inference, reducing friction without sacrificing precision or privacy.

5 Searches → 1 Sentence Logging Time Reduction
100% On-Device Privacy
Learn More →

Applai: From Job Posting to Interview-Ready Application

Career Technology

Applai turns a fragmented, repetitive application process into one focused workflow. It can read a job posting, understand a candidate's experience, and produce a truthful, role-specific resume with ATS assessment and cover-letter support. Conversational refinement keeps the candidate in control, while deterministic validation turns AI output into polished, ready-to-use application documents.

3 Workflows One Application Workspace
URL → CV End-to-End Automation
Build With Us →

Mirai Engine: From Experimental Data to Better Designs

Scientific & Industrial AI

Mirai Engine gives scientific and engineering teams a governed path from complex experimental data to the next best experiment. A reusable, manifest-driven data contract replaces brittle one-off scripts, while automated preprocessing, surrogate-model training, model comparison, design exploration, and Bayesian optimization bring the complete experimentation lifecycle into one auditable platform.

1 Package Full ML Lifecycle
Human-Governed Model Promotion
Build With Us →

Molecular Optimization with AI

Advanced Materials

We were involved in the early days of molecular-modeling with Artificial Neural Networks, nowadays spread as Graph Neural Networks. We reduced the experimental design of new eco-friendly fuels (e-Fuels) from several weeks to seconds. Our optimization framework can produce tailored-made fuel structures that maximize power output while using only carbon-free components in the chemical structure.

Weeks → Seconds Design Time Reduction
100% Carbon-Free
Learn More →

AI Market Analyst Agent

Financial Technology

Our AI agent can continuously monitor global news streams and transform them into actionable market insights in real time. Using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and vector database holding hundreds of thousands of articles, the agent provides instant, conversational access to market updates through WhatsApp integration.

100K+ Articles Analyzed
WhatsApp Instant Access
Learn More →

Real-Time Market Forecasting

Financial Markets

Following our AI Lifecycle methodology, we built a fully end-to-end machine learning system for real-time market prediction using live data streams. The system incorporates different AI models that are continuously & automatically retrained to tackle data drift. It includes a sentiment analysis pipeline via fine-tuned LLMs, and a production-ready infrastructure with Kubernetes/Docker, Apache Kafka, and MLflow. Demonstrates enterprise-grade ML engineering with comprehensive monitoring.

Real-Time Processing
LLM-Powered Sentiment Analysis
Learn More →

Medical Image Segmentation

Healthcare

Doctors can spend weeks to months to manually segment kidney vasculature from high-resolution 3D HiP-CT scans. We developed an automated segmentation system using an ANN with a U-Net architecture to analyze kidney vasculature from those high-resolution 3D HiP-CT scans. The model achieves 97% accuracy, reducing segmentation time from months to hours per dataset. This supports helps the professionals to focus on the more of their ressources on more complex parts of the kidney while sparing time.

97% Accuracy Rate
Months → Hours Processing Time
Learn More →
